output_list.reason: Integer overflow in mintToken function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
sell function allows a potential trap due to overflow of 'amount * sellPrice' in comparison to 'this.balance'.
buy function allows a potential trap due to overflow of 'amount' in comparison to 'balanceOf[this]'.
transferFrom function allows a potential trap due to overflow of 'balanceOf[_to] + _value' in comparison to 'balanceOf[_to]'.
transfer function allows a potential trap due to overflow of 'balanceOf[_to] + _value' in comparison to 'balanceOf[_to]'.
